# Tender response -- PKHYVA-2026-0087

## Visakoivu Oy

Visakoivu Oy is a technical and property services contractor based in Jyvaskyla, providing LVI, electrical, building automation and property maintenance services to public and private clients across Central Finland. This response is structured around the evaluation criteria set out in Section 8 of the notice: price, technical quality of the maintenance and installation plan, and references.

### Eligibility

Visakoivu Oy holds a valid NMSB 7310:2015 certificate (valid until 2027-06-30). Visakoivu holds electrical contracting rights at class S1, exceeding the required class S2. Qualifying reference: framework agreement with Jarviseudun hyvinvointialue (public sector), EUR 1,650,000, 2021-08-01 to 2024-07-31, property maintenance and HVAC upkeep across five health centres.

### Technical quality of the maintenance and installation plan

**Spare parts.** Lead times are stated by manufacturer and part class; common items are held in stock, so most call-outs are resolved without waiting on a supplier order.

**Fire protection.** Serviced on a scheduled interval consistent with system type and manufacturer requirements.

**Emergency response.** 4-hour response to fault call-outs, supported by an on-call duty roster covering all contract properties.

**Register and documentation.** The property register and associated documentation are maintained throughout the contract period and handed over in full at contract end.

**Safety plan.** Work is carried out under our NMSB 75310:2018 occupational health and safety management system.

Escalation of unresolved faults, the installation method statement and elevator servicing follow our standard maintenance procedures and are available on request.

### Commercial terms

Pricing is index-linked annually against the relevant cost index. Our liability under this agreement is limited in accordance with standard commercial terms. Contract period is 5 years, with the extension option described in Section 5.

### References

As above: Jarviseudun hyvinvointialue, EUR 1,650,000, public sector, comparable scope and sector to this procurement.

### Forms

Key personnel CVs are enclosed. The certificate of pension insurance contributions is enclosed.

### Format

Prices are quoted excluding VAT, in EUR, with a per-property and per-m2 basis both shown.

Visakoivu Oy confirms its intention to bid for this framework agreement.
